title: Forest webs and pattern avoidance
summary: In a recent preprint, Mike Cummings showed that the smooth components of suitably parametrized Springer fibers are in bijection with contracted, fully reduced Plücker degree-two $\mathfrak{sl}_r$-webs of standard type and that are forests. He showed these are enumerated by sequence A116731 in the OEIS, which is equinumerous with permutations avoiding the patterns {321,2143,3124}. Cummings posed the problem of strengthening this enumerative result by finding a bijection between these webs and a collection of pattern-avoiding permutations.
